I traced this through the source (`src/run.ts`, `src/thread.ts`, `src/extensions.ts`, `src/durable-extensions.ts`, plus pi-durable 1.5.2 and pit v0.35.1 as installed on this runner). The short answer: **pi-action doesn't load `AGENTS.md` or skills at all.** pi extensions add model providers and nothing else. pi-durable extensions such as pit are the only thing that adds text to the system prompt. With no `extensions` input, the system prompt is empty and the model gets only the tool definitions.

Everything below is laid out for a made-up repo **`acme/xyz`**, checked out at `/home/runner/work/xyz/xyz`, with this config:

```yaml
- uses: cv/pi-action@v2
  with:
    extensions: |
      github:cv/pit#v0.35.1        # pi-durable extension
      ./.pi/extensions/gateway.ts  # pi extension (provider)
```

Someone comments `@pi fix the flaky test` on **xyz issue #12**.

## 1. What each kind of file does in pi-action

| Thing in xyz | Loaded? | Where it ends up |
|---|---|---|
| `xyz/AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` | ❌ never loaded by pi-action | Nowhere, unless the model reads it with `read` or `bash`. Then it's a tool result in the conversation. ([how-it-works.md](docs/how-it-works.md#commit-conventions) says so too.) |
| `~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md`, other `AGENTS.md` files up the directory tree | ❌ | Nowhere |
| Skills (`SKILL.md`, `pi.skills`) | ❌ | Nowhere, not even skill descriptions |
| Prompt templates (`pi.prompts`, for example pit's `./prompts`) | ❌ | Nowhere |
| pi extension (`gateway.ts`, `pi.extensions`) | ✅ at setup | Only `pi.registerProvider()` is used, to add models. Tools, commands, event handlers and UI get a warning in the log and are dropped. |
| pi-durable extension (pit's `pi.durable`) | ✅ at setup | Its **tools** go into the tool list and its **sections** go into the system prompt. If a package has both `pi.durable` and `pi.extensions`, only `pi.durable` is loaded. |
| pit project config (`xyz/.pi/pit.json`, `xyz/.pi/functions`) | Only if `trust_project: true` | The `

ops:
<pit_project_functions>` section |
| pit user functions (`agent_dir`, by default a fresh `$RUNNER_TEMP/pi-action-agent-*`) | ✅, but the default directory starts empty | The `<pit_user_functions>`
